items.text: Puka Nacua listed questionable (hip/groin soreness post-Thu practice) for MNF vs NYG; will not practice Sat, pre-game decision. Whittington doubtful (quad).
items.why: Hip injury + groin soreness after Thursday; DNP Fri/Sat per McVay. Unrelated to camp psoas.
items.implication: Have pivot ready for MNF; risk starting if active but monitor warmups.
items.opportunity: If out, heavier TE (Ferguson/Parkinson) and WR Konata Mumpfield or Malachi Fields bump; Whittington also doubtful.

items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs NO due to hamstring; previously doubtful/Q path.
items.why: Hamstring from Week 1; missed practices, downgraded Saturday.
items.implication: Sit Flowers; BAL WR room thinned further with Lane also out.
items.opportunity: Rashod Bateman, Devontez Walker, others rise in hierarchy for targets/routes.

items.text: TE Brock Bowers doubtful for Sunday (knee); Raiders elevated TE Chris Myarick and WR Cody White.
items.why: Knee (post-meniscus); limited Friday, game-time test expected.
items.implication: Prepare to sit; low chance of full role even if active.
items.opportunity: Elevated Myarick for TE snaps; other LV pass-catchers gain routes.

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT (foot) for Sunday vs NE; was previously questionable.
items.implication: Sit Pittman; PIT WR targets to others (Metcalf, etc.).
items.opportunity: DK Metcalf and remaining PIT pass-catchers see increased share.

items.text: Nico Collins (hamstring) ruled OUT for Week 2 vs CIN after missing practices; confirmed across reports.
items.why: Hamstring suffered in Wednesday practice; DNP Thu/Fri.
items.implication: Remove from all lineups; HOU WR targets redistribute.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining HOU WRs (Hutchinson, Boutte, Noel, Coker) and TE Dalton Schultz.

items.text: Joe Burrow listed questionable (back) but expected to play vs HOU; Bengals elevated QB Josh Johnson as precaution.
items.why: Back issue; practiced, coach/positive comments, said he's playing.
items.implication: Start Burrow with high confidence; elevation is backup insurance.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest injury question on the slate; impacts Justin Herbert projections heavily. Game at 4pm ET.
items.why: Ribs from Week 1; limited/missed early practices, returned limited Friday.
items.implication: Monitor inactives closely; if out, Herbert and LAC WR hierarchy shift (Johnston up).
items.opportunity: Quentin Johnston and other LAC WRs see expanded targets/routes if McConkey sits.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson IN for 2026 debut vs PIT; Patriots desperate for playmakers with AJ Brown on IR. Potential for 10+ touches vs Stevenson.
items.why: Ankle cleared; full practices, self-declared ready. Timing good with Brown IR and favorable upcoming schedule.
items.implication: Flex/RB3 upside in debut; monitor split with Stevenson but explosive potential high.
items.opportunity: Carries, routes, and big-play role expansion possible immediately; NE needs playmakers.
items.conflict: Could still be secondary to Stevenson early.

items.text: Alvin Kamara listed IN for Week 2; expected back, squeezing NO backfield.
items.implication: Kamara reclaims significant role; Etienne usage further limited.
items.opportunity: Kamara snaps/targets/carries; reverse prior Etienne beneficiaries.

items.text: Giving Christian McCaffrey a bump off Week 1 usage regardless; Kaelon Black (groin) status still matters for SF backfield.
items.why: Strong Week 1 usage data; Black status secondary but relevant.
items.implication: CMC remains elite start with potential volume increase.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry/target share continuation or expansion.

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% route targets (team lead). IND allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite Week 1 utilization + soft matchup vs weak IND run D.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start; high floor/ceiling from dual usage.
items.opportunity: Sustained high snap, carry, and target share.

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization score Week 1 (tied Bijan lead), 19% target share recent, 25+ touches in 3 of last 4.
items.why: Dominant utilization and passing-game involvement; soft LAC matchup.

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: 26% target share, all RB red-zone touches Week 1 (RB9 util); CLE soft vs run (121 yds/4.8 YPC).
items.why: Passing-game and goal-line dominance + favorable matchup.

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: Matched Kendre Miller rushes Week 1, most points via air; Kamara return squeezes role further as underdogs.
items.why: Concerning split usage + Kamara expected back + poor script.
items.implication: Sit or fade; committee risk high.
items.opportunity: Reduced carries/targets with Kamara reclaiming work.
